issues.issue: A housing authority with 114,118.10 of property tax is implausible. This is probably tenant rent and/or HUD subsidy entered on the waiver form's property-tax line. Recorded as printed and marked review; a person should confirm.
The form does not split principal and interest. Debt service principal is equally defensible; marked review.
Fiscal year end was assumed (noted in notes); the form prints no period.
